scope: Current A1/C1 assessment snapshots and source-owned native A1/C1 practice candidates; existing all-assessment precautionary reservations remain additive.

manual_reservations.test_item: Part 2, Q7 amplitude and Q8 definition of SHM
manual_reservations.reason: Explicit definition/meaning/conditions tasks reproduce the same assessed recall. Numerical applications, graph-derived values and requests to demonstrate SHM for a particular force law are not included merely because their context mentions SHM.

05M.P2.HL.TZ2.QB2 frequency part inherits '(b) Define, for a wave,' from parent_context; the SL appearance combines frequency and wavelength. Both reproduce the standalone frequency definition and are reserved with their full parents.

manual_reservations.test_item: Q7, phase between displacement and acceleration
manual_reservations.reason: 19M.P1.HL.TZ1.Q11 and SLQ14 ask the same phase difference. The school version changes distractor order/values; the demanded phase and physical conditions are unchanged. HL original crop was visually verified; SL native text and source identity match and whole-level closure withholds both. The SL focused crop currently contains only its printed number, which is also unsuitable for serving.

manual_reservations.test_item: Part 2 Q18(a)(i), horizontal and vertical acceleration without air resistance
manual_reservations.reason: 05N.P3.SL.TZ0.QA1(a) asks the horizontal and vertical acceleration of a stone in flight with negligible air resistance: zero and g downwards. This is the same two-value recall requested for the rock on its way up in the current test; launch direction and unused numerical context do not change that task. Reserve the whole source parent without claiming that the entire authored rock/beach-ball test question was copied.

manual_reservations.test_item: Part 2 Q19, direction of velocity and acceleration just after the parachute opens
manual_reservations.reason: 19M.P1.HL.TZ1.Q3 and its SL twin ask the directions of the skydiver's velocity and acceleration after opening a parachute, before reaching a new terminal speed. These reproduce the downwards/upwards answers in the current test table's one-second-after-opening column. Reserve both appearances; this does not identify the entire custom 800 N / 40 s / two-minute timeline as an original exam question.

manual_reservations.test_item: Part 2 Q8, displacement-proportionality criterion of SHM
manual_reservations.reason: 09M.P1.SL.TZ2.Q11 and13M.P1.SL.TZ1.Q12 ask which quantity the restoring force or acceleration is proportional to. This reproduces the displacement-from-equilibrium criterion explicitly allocated one mark in the knowledge-test definition. These are direct conceptual recall MCQs with no numerical application; the13M original crop was visually verified.

manual_reservations.test_item: Part 2 Q9, meaning of displacement-time gradient
manual_reservations.reason: 10N.P1.SL.TZ0.Q4 asks which graph feature gives speed at a point on an increasing displacement-time curve. Its visually reviewed graph has symbolic coordinates and no numerical calculation; selecting the gradient repeats the knowledge-resit gradient/velocity relation. The source uses speed on a positive-gradient branch, so this is a conservative equivalent-recall reservation rather than an exact wording claim.

All11 pages were visually read and compared against the29 fixed C1 candidates, using complete native prompt/stem/context fields and targeted source crop comparisons. No additional identical task was found. Specific counterexamples include source16M.HLQ24 mass4M/length0.25l versus the mini-test mass2M/length2l; source20N.HLQ27 compares mass changes in pendulum and spring systems, whereas the mini-test changes gravity for one mass-spring system. Different numerical or initial-condition tasks were not equated merely through common SHM vocabulary.

reviewed_nonmatches.test_item: Authored Q1, Q18 and Q19 against fixed197 A1 candidates
reviewed_nonmatches.finding: All candidate identities and native question/stem/parent-context fields were checked, with targeted rereading of short recall and projectile/drag/skydiver tasks. Added exact source-ID reservations for acceleration-component and post-parachute vector recall. Other surviving tasks require different numerical data, diagram transformations, initial conditions, motion stages or operations. Existing weak/candidate reservations remain fully additive; absence of automated text hits alone was not used as clearance.

limitations: Review completion is scoped to A1/C1 and does not certify every assessment item across all IB topics.
Whole-parent, cross-level, duplicate and page/geometry closure must be applied downstream before serving either question or context images.
School tests dated2026 were read only for exclusion evidence; no exam-paper content dated2026 or later is eligible.
The final image/geometry gate remains a separate prerequisite; this file does not authorize any question-image publication.
